path.id: The primary color, fluorescent green, is derived from the bioluminescence of rainforest leaves under extreme light conditions and the subtle glow of moss at night, symbolizing the unknown vitality and safety guidance of the outdoors. The auxiliary colors, orange and blue, correspond to the warm evening light piercing through the mist and the deep lake blue of alpine glaciers, respectively, jointly constructing a visual system that originates from nature, serves functional purposes, and is achieved through digital meansThe primary color, fluorescent green, is derived from the bioluminescence of rainforest leaves under extreme light conditions and the subtle glow of moss at night, symbolizing the unknown vitality and safety guidance of the outdoors. The graphic design uses a vibrant and immersive outdoor visual language. Classic outdoor elements such as tents, snow-capped mountain silhouettes, and hiking trails are extracted to represent features like the challenge, gear shop, and community for outdoor enthusiasts.

The graphic design focuses on a trendy and novel tone, reconstructing outdoor elements in 3D. It emphasizes the reuse and variation of the explosive graphic elements in English, constructing a unified visual symbol. C

The graphic design focuses on a trendy and novel tone, reconstructing outdoor elements in 3D. It emphasizes the reuse and variation of the explosive graphic elements in English, constructing a unified visual symbol. Combining highly saturated trendy colors with a smooth, transparent texture, it injects approachability into a distinctly modern feel, presenting a fresh and interesting brand image.

Achi is a cactus born beside a desert highway. I chose a cactus because it embodies the core spirit of outdoor enthusiasts: resiliently growing in a harsh environment, yet brimming with vitality and moisture within. It proves that the coolest adventurers often come from the most unexpected places
